hero_kpi_rationale: EPAM Systems reached $5.46 billion in revenue in 2025 with 15.4% growth, driven by digital engineering services, cloud and AI, consolidated through strategic acquisitions of NEORIS and First Derivative.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from digital transformation and software engineering services.
kpis.description: Revenue reached $5.46 billion in 2025, growing 15.4%, with 9.2% contribution from NEORIS and First Derivative acquisitions in Q4 2024.
kpis.signal: Robust growth driven by AI, cloud and acquisitions

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of services, excluding depreciation.
kpis.description: Gross margin stands at 28.8% in 2025 (100% - 71.2% cost of revenue ratio), up 1.9 percentage points from 26.9% in 2024, reflecting improved operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating revenue divided by total revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined to 9.5% in 2025 from 11.5% in 2024, likely due to post-acquisition integration costs and strategic investments in AI and cloud.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Expenses related to innovation and development of new technology offerings, as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses (including amortization) represent 1.8% of revenue in 2025, up from 1.4% in 2024, supported by EPAM AI/RUN initiatives and DIALX Lab.
kpis.signal: Accelerating investments in AI and proprietary platforms

kpis.name: Total Headcount (in thousands)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees worldwide at the end of the period.
kpis.description: EPAM had approximately 65,000 employees at end of 2025, up sharply 15% driven by acquisitions of NEORIS and First Derivative in Q4 2024.
kpis.signal: Rapid workforce growth supported by strategic acquisitions

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Cash and Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of $1.3B last year

kpis.name: Financial Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from financial services sector clients, EPAM's largest vertical.
kpis.description: Financial Services represents 24.1% of total revenue with $1.32 billion in 2025, up 28.6% from $1.02 billion in 2024, remaining the largest vertical.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by digital transformation and AI in financial institutions

kpis.name: Americas Revenue (geography)
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from clients based in North, Central and South America.
kpis.description: Americas represents 58.7% of total revenue with $3.20 billion in 2025, growing 12.9% from $2.84 billion in 2024, supported by acquisitions and existing demand.
kpis.signal: Solid organic growth in the largest geographic region

risks.title: Uncertain accounting estimates
risks.score_rationale: The risk is discussed in the introduction to critical accounting policies, with strong language on estimation uncertainty. It directly impacts financial statements and is recurring annually. The Capital category is heavily weighted.

risks.title: Variable revenue recognition
risks.score_rationale: Positioned early in risk factors, with language emphasizing uncertainty and possible material impact. Explicit mention of judgment usage for discounts, credits and incentives. Recurring risk amplified by contract diversity.

risks.title: Business combinations and asset valuations
risks.score_rationale: Discussed in detail with strong terms such as 'uncertain by nature' and 'significant impact on future amortization'. Large portion of purchase price allocated to intangible assets. Capital category very heavily weighted.

risks.title: Valuation of deferred considerations
risks.score_rationale: Mention of complex methods (Monte Carlo) and dependence on financial projections. Changes in assumptions drive direct accounting adjustments. High position in text and language intensity.

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.score_rationale: Although concentration is declining, top 10 customers still represent 21.6% of revenues. Explicit mention of account maturity fluctuations. Cautious language but not alarmist.

risks.title: Evolution of service models
risks.score_rationale: The shift to integrated solutions (AI, cybersecurity, cloud) is highlighted as a key evolution. This implies risks around adaptation, skills and customer demand. Forward-looking language but with moderate intensity.

ai_positioning.summary: EPAM integrates AI into its services and products, notably through strategic acquisitions. The company uses AI to enhance its offerings and potentially its internal operations.
